title.narrative: (CONSORTIUM) Provision of integrated lifesaving responses to populations affected by displacement and famine in South Darfur.

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project is a consortium-led initiative involving Alight, World Vision International (WVI), JIMCO, and the Great Family Organization (GFO), designed to provide integrated lifesaving humanitarian assistance to populations severely impacted by displacement, conflict, and famine in South Darfur, Sudan.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtltbgtGeographical Coverage:lt/bgt The intervention will focus on four key localities: Nyala North, Nyala South, Sharq al Jebel, and Al Sunta. It is anticipated that the project will directly benefit approximately 279,923 individuals from both IDP and host communities.nbsplt/pgtltpgtltbgtTargeted numbers:lt/bgtltbrgt 119,732 individuals accessing primary health care services.ltbrgt 40,617 people receiving WASH interventions, ensuring access to clean water and sanitation.ltbrgt 36,500 individuals targeted for emergency shelter and non-food items (NFI).ltbrgt 35,458 individuals receiving comprehensive protection services.ltbrgtltbgtKey Activities: lt/bgtltbrgtHealth: Operate and support Primary Health Care clinics to provide maternal and child health services, reproductive health, and routine immunization, as well as disease surveillance and outbreak response. The project will also train health workers and rehabilitate health facilities to ensure continuity of care for vulnerable populations.ltbrgtltbrgtNutrition: PromotenbspIYCF practices, treatment of severe and moderate acute malnutrition through CMAM programs and conducting mass nutrition screenings for children under five and pregnant and lactating women. Food demonstration campaigns and support for household kitchen gardens will also enhance food security and nutritional outcomes.ltbrgtWASH: Rehabilitation of water points and construction of latrines in IDP camps and host communities. Hygiene promotion activities will aim to improve sanitation practices and reduce the incidence of waterborne diseases. The project will also distribute hygiene kits to vulnerable households and provide water trucking services where necessary.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtES/NFI: Provision of emergency shelter and distribution of non-food items to IDPs and conflict-affected populations, including shelter kits, blankets, cooking utensils, and dignity kits for women. The project will conduct needs assessments to ensure timely and targeted distribution of these items to households most in need.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtProtection: Establishment of community-based protection networks and provision of mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) to vulnerable groups, especially women and children. The project will construct safe spaces in IDP camps, conduct GBV awareness campaigns, and provide case management for GBV survivors. Distribution of dignity kits and protection monitoring will further enhance the safety and dignity of affected individuals.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtltbgtAnticipated Outcomeslt/bgtnbspof this intervention include:ltbrgt Improved Health Outcomes: Enhanced access to essential health services is projected to reduce maternal and child morbidity and mortality rates in the targeted communities.ltbrgt Increased Nutritional Status: The promotion of IYCF practices and provision of nutritional support is expected to contribute to a decrease in malnutrition rates among children and pregnant and lactating women (PLW).ltbrgt Enhanced Water and Sanitation Services: Rehabilitation of water points and construction of latrines will significantly improve access to safe water and sanitation facilities, contributing to better hygiene practices and reduced incidence of waterborne diseases.lt/pgtltpgt Strengthened Protection Mechanisms: Establishing community-based protection networks and providing support to vulnerable groups, particularly women and children, will foster a safer environment and enhance community resilience against violence and exploitation.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThis intervention represents a comprehensive and collaborativenbspeffort to address the multifaceted challenges faced by displaced and conflict affected populations in South Darfur, ensuring a coordinated and effective response through the consortium arrangementnbspcollaboratingnbspwith local authorities, community leaders, and relevant government ministries.ltbrgtlt/pgt
